messages:
jordan: Heads up — Sentry alerted on staging logs containing what looks like a KMS key id and a truncated ciphertext. not in cleartext, but still counts.

sara: can you paste the exact log snippet? is it a service account email or a key resource name?

jordan: snippet below, redacted a bit:
```
ERROR: failed to decrypt blob: projects/project-123/locations/global/keyRings/ring-foo/cryptoKeys/key-prod: ciphertext=CiQA...e3f
```

mike: ugh. that looks like a KMS resource path, probably from a backup job that logged the wrapped blob id. not the raw secret but still sensitive.

alice: agreed. treat as potential leak. first actions: 1) scope blast radius (which environments saw this), 2) revoke any credentials that used that KMS key for signing/decrypting if possible, 3) ensure audit logs preserved.

sara: Jordan — which pod/replica emitted that? looks like a backup job, can you grep recent pod logs in staging?

jordan: running quick grep now:
```
kubectl -n staging logs -l app=backup --since=2h | grep "failed to decrypt blob" -n
```

jordan: found 3 entries from backup-job-7cj4 (node stg-3). I also see a partner webhook invocation shortly before. tagging @mike for partner egress review.

mike: pinged partner eng. meanwhile I'll open a short-lived deny policy on the vault cluster for the backup service account until we confirm.

alice: good. we should also rotate the transit key used to unwrap if it's backed by our folder key. @vault-bot can we trigger a transit-rotate for ring-foo/key-prod and emit audit entries?

vault-bot: Received request: schedule transit rotation for projects/project-123/locations/global/keyRings/ring-foo/cryptoKeys/key-prod. Rotation started. Audit token: a1b2c3.

sara: @oncall — please snapshot Cloud Audit Logs for the last 24h for IAM/KMS and GCS access in staging project, export to secure bucket (retention 90d) before any deletion.

oncall: Ack. exporting now to gs://sec-archives/staging-leak-3176543210/ — will DM when complete.

alice: quick RBAC change: mike, apply this iam binding removal for the backup SA so it can't call KMS_encrypt or KMS_decrypt in staging until we confirm:
```
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding project-123 \\
  --member=serviceAccount:backup-sa@project-123.iam.gserviceaccount.com \\
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```

mike: running plan in infra sandbox then will apply. also scanning infra for any other SAs with that role.

jordan: partner replied: their webhook only received status callbacks, not the blob. they confirm no downloads of the wrapped blob.

sara: still proceed with rotation. assume worst-case.

mike: applied the iam removal in staging. terraform diff attached (redacted): removed 1 binding.

alice: nice. after vault-bot rotation completes, run a controlled rewrap of any stored backups that used key-prod and issue new ciphertexts. include a checklist for owners.

vault-bot: Rotation complete for key-prod. New primary version: 6. Audit entries created: audit/3176543210/key-rotation.log

sara: Jordan — can you prepare a short list of backup blobs referencing key-prod (names/paths) and owners? we'll contact owners to re-encrypt.

jordan: list coming. found ~12 blobs in gs://backups/staging/2026-03-21/* that reference the old ciphertext header.

alice: ping owners, set 48h window to rewrap. after 48h, we'll rotate the key again and revoke any legacy decrypt permissions. include automated script for rewrap:
```
for f in $(gsutil ls gs://backups/staging/2026-03-21/*); do
  # download metadata, rewrap with new key version
  python scripts/rewrap_backup.py --file "$f" --kms-key projects/project-123/locations/global/keyRings/ring-foo/cryptoKeys/key-prod/cryptoKeyVersions/6
done
```

mike: also adding an audit-redaction ticket to prevent these resource paths from being logged moving forward by the backup job — will land a change that strips KMS resource names from logs and logs only a redacted id.

sara: filing incident ticket (sev3) for tracking: INC-2026-0317-01 with the timeline and actions. I'll attach exported audit logs once @oncall confirms the export.

oncall: export complete, bucket path in ticket.

jordan: owners notified. partner confirmed no exfil.

alice: final items: 1) add a short-lived alert that monitors for plaintext-like regexes and KMS resource patterns in app logs, 2) update runbook with this scenario and checklist, 3) schedule a 30m postmortem tomorrow.

mike: will push the logging scrub and alert rule in a patch PR, link shortly.

sara: thanks all. closing timeline: detection -> RBAC lockdown -> key rotation -> backup rewrap plan -> audit preservation. follow-up in INC-2026-0317-01. :white_check_mark:
